title: The Epic of Runners
subtitle: A warm flame adorned with honey-like tears. This half is for you, and this half is for me. My friend... I miss you so much.

trails.title: Sports Field Opening Ceremony
trails.description: Let's make this a day to remember. Sing for me, and sing for yourself, too.

trails.title: Face Yourself
trails.description: The torch relay comes to a halt here. The flame is on the verge of losing control, but your hands are not as weak as they once were.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The audience are all seated. No stampede or jostle, not to mention injury.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: All the human athletes have registered, and their mixed sporting events with arcanist athletes have been properly planned and are ready to start in three days!

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Aah! I'm done. I can't even move a finger right now.
This is almost a miracle.
Everyone is running, running, and running for the tremendous workload, like a python trying to digest an elephant. Fortunately, they manage to complete all the work just on time.

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: Come on, Flammy.

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: It's our turn.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Hah ... Haha, again we walk on this glorious path together, Ulu!

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: Run.

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: Get yourself running, child.

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: Light up the Uluru torch, as you have promised!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: As ... I have promised!
Her ribs tremble excitedly as Spathodea's heart flutters like a bird, now flapping its wings to fly away.
Tired as her body is, the way Spathodea runs is as lively as her heart.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: I am running. Even though the day I last ran here was a thousand years ago, it feels just like yesterday to me.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: I run across the long track, stepping on the burning red soil. I am sweating, like a sparkling star! I am going to the top of the Stadium to light up the torch ...

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Ulu, Ulu!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Have I grown up like you wished for me? Am I a new and different me now?
Cheers, songs, whistles, and clicks encourage the girl forward.
She runs as fast as she can, calling out.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: This is just a moment of my life, but I know you've waited a million days and nights for it! I want you to be proud! I want you to be happy!

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: My friend, my dear friend!

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: You're my Flammy, but you're so much more than that ...

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: You're also my Spathodea ... My little girl ...!

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: You have grown up, as I have dreamed of countless times. The snakes here didn't lay a single tooth on you. Both your body and mind are intact.

items.speaker: Audience
items.text: Hey, what's that? The Uluru Flame is dropping water!

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: *sobs*

items.speaker: Ulu
items.text: *cries out loudly*

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: U-Ulu?!
The flame is put out by her tears. The little Priestess stops running subconsciously, which makes her lose her balance.
She falls forward to the ground.

items.speaker: Audience
items.text: Flame! The Uluru Flame! It's ...!

items.speaker: Audience
items.text: It's-It's the kid of Laplace!

items.speaker: Audience
items.text: Flame! The Uluru Flame! It's lit up again!
The flame that revives is burning in their joined hands, feeling warm and comfortable.
Ezra finally hears the people's cheers as he looks around at a loss.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: We ... we did it!

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: The opening ceremony took place just as we planned!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Yes, YES! We made it! Thank you, Ezra!
Spathodea holds the weak Ulu gently while holding the boy in her arms.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: The flame is burning in your hand. You ... You share the same thought, don't you? It wouldn't have burned on you if you weren't wishing for the Games sincerely!

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Yes, I, I do. I want it to be a successful event.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: It's important to you, and so to us now.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: With a smile on his face, Ezra holds Spathodea's hand and lifts it in the air.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Mankind and arcanists who are here with us or following the event through radio, TV, or internet, I invite you to witness the blazing of the Uluru torch.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: She is Ulu, the noble spirit of peace, hard work, and competition.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: In the past thousands of years, the holy fire has been to the highest mountain and touched the rocks in the deepest sea, taking the peace and all other noble qualities to every corner of this world.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: It was also brought out of this world, into space by rockets, and traveled among the stars. From ships, to spaceships, from one hand to another, it has journeyed far.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: And now, for the first time, the torch to be lit has come to the flame.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: The flame is burning in the joint hands of human and arcanist.

items.speaker: Spathodea&Ezra
items.text: We hereby swear we shall forget the hatred, conflict, turbulence, and chaos of the past.

items.speaker: Spathodea&Ezra
items.text: We shall run in the name of sportsmanship. We shall walk in the original form of men.

items.speaker: Spathodea&Ezra
items.text: We shall compete against each other, not for victory but for participation.
